{{Quote|Maybe this tactical droid will tell us how they knew our plan.|Clone Captain Rex|audio=ChristophsisTacticalDroid1a-THE.flac|<ref name="THE" />}}
'''TJ-55''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it and [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Christophsis)/Legends|another tactical droid]] were stationed on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] with the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces of the [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]], which [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Soon after the invasion, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent an [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Army]] detachment led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to liberate the planet.

During the battle between Republic and Separatist forces, TJ-55 led an ambush on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] forces at a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|business complex]] in [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]]. As the remaining Republic forces tried to evacuate from the roof of the South tower, the tactical droid led a squad of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] to attack the retreating [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. However, during the fighting, the droid's head was ripped off by [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Gus/Legends|Gus]] and was brought back to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic's base]] for a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]]. The investigation only confirmed that there was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] amongst the Republic's [[Troop/Legends|troops]] before the droid stopped processing. The spy was eventually revealed to be [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]], who was later apprehended.

==Biography==
===Battle of Christophsis===
{{Quote|The Republic army is in the north and south towers, level 46.|TJ-55, during a robolobotomy|audio=ChristophsisTacticalDroid1b-THE.flac|<ref name="THE" />}}
[[File:Tactical_droid_chris.png|thumb|right|300px|TJ-55 leads the attack.]]
Manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]],<ref name="GAW" /> TJ-55,<ref name="Complete Season One">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|episode=The Hidden Enemy|tcw=1}}</ref> a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]],<ref name="GAW" /> served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="THE" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> it<ref name="Episode Guide" /> and [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Christophsis)/Legends|another tactical droid]] were assigned to help [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] of the [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]], an ally organization of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|conquer]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. However, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to liberate the planet.<ref name="THE" />

After landing, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began to prepare an ambush, but [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]], a Separatist [[Spy/Legends|spy]] embedded within the Republic forces, informed the Confederacy about the Republic's plan, and the location of the Republic forces was transmitted into TJ-55. Unaware of this, the Republic set up several [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannons]] in a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|double-towered business center]] in [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]] and prepared to open fire at the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces as they passed through the [[City/Legends|city]] [[plaza]] below.<ref name="THE" />

[[File:ChristophsisDroidBattalion.png|thumb|left|300px|Separatist battle droids led by TJ-55 march on Christophsis.]]
Consequently, by the time the tactical droid led its forces to the towers, it was well aware of the presence of Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. It commanded its [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] forces from its [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] and surprised the Jedi and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] by splitting its troops, thus bypassing the ambush. Battle droids then attacked the south-facing tower, where Kenobi was with his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. The droids pinned down Kenobi and his clones, but Skywalker noticed the situation from the north tower. He signaled an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] for an evacuation and led his clone troopers to help Kenobi. The Republic forces were able to hold their ground but were forced to retreat with the battle droids' larger numbers. As the Jedi and remaining clones took a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the roof, where the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] was landing for evacuation, TJ-55 left its [[Tank/Legends|tank]] and followed the Republic troopers with its droid forces.<ref name="THE" />

===Downfall and robolobotomy===
{{Quote|It just doesn't make sense. Blast!|Rex, as the head of TJ-55 deactivates after revealing its information|audio=ItJustDoesntMakeSense-TheHiddenEnemy.flac|<ref name="THE" />}}
[[File:TacticalDroidDecapitated-THE.png|thumb|right|300px|TJ-55's head is ripped off by Gus.]]
On the roof of the south tower, the tactical droid led the attack of the battle droids in order to prevent the retreat of the Republic troops. Equipped with an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]], it managed to shoot at least one clone trooper during the [[Lightfight|firefight]].<ref name="THE" /> However, clone trooper [[Gus/Legends|Gus]]<ref name="Episode Guide" /> saw the tactical droid, jumped for it, ripped its head off, and leaped onto the Republic gunship as it departed from the tower. While the gunship left, the still-functioning body of TJ-55 rotated senselessly, shooting several misaimed shots on its own.<ref name="THE" />

Later on, at the Republic's [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Christophsis base]], TJ-55's head was analyzed in a [[Robolobotomy/Legends|robolobotomy]] by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. The droid's data files only verified that the Separatists had gained secret information about the positions of the Republic forces before the head stopped processing, ruining any chances of further analysis. Despite this, the spy was discovered to be [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick, who was apprehended,<ref name="THE" /> and General Loathsom's droid forces were eventually defeated as well.<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:Tactical_droid_robolobotomy.png|thumb|left|250px|TJ-55's head reveals its information.]]
Like all tactical droids, TJ-55 stood 1.93 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="TCWCE" /> was far more intelligent than standard battle droids of the Separatist Droid Army, and was not controlled by a [[Computer/Legends|computer]], allowing it to think and function independently.<ref name="IoR">{{SW|url=video/innocents-of-ryloth-episode-featurette|text="Innocents of Ryloth" Episode Featurette}}</ref> In battle, it gave its orders from its Armored Assault Tank, but it was also ready to leave its tank and attack with its troops at close combat range, where it used its E-5 blaster rifle.<ref name="THE" /> The droid had the word "TACTICAL" written along the side of its head in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]],<ref name="Episode Guide" /> and it also had [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]].<ref name="THE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JAT.jpg|thumb|right|190px|James Arnold Taylor, TJ-55's voice actor]]
TJ-55 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television episode "[[The Hidden Enemy]],"<ref name="THE" /> which aired on [[February 6]], [[2009]]. The character was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]], who also provided the voice of Obi-Wan Kenobi and the second tactical droid in the same episode.<ref name="Episode Guide" /> Even though the droid appeared unnamed in the episode,<ref name="THE" /> the droid was later named TJ-55 by its concept art, first presented<ref name="Complete Season One" /> on [[November 3]], 2009,<ref name="Complete Season 1 date">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091102/index.html|text=A Tour of ''The Clone Wars'': The Complete Season One Box Set (Part Three)}}</ref> in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]] home video release's "Jedi Temple Archives" behind the scenes extra for "The Hidden Enemy."<ref name="Complete Season One" />

The events surrounding the capture of TJ-55's head were also humorously portrayed in the non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', wherein one of the playable characters&mdash;Skywalker, Kenobi, CC-2224, or a clone trooper&mdash;has to put on the droid's head in order to use a special panel and gain access to the arriving gunship to escape from the South tower's roof.<ref name="LEGO SW III">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
